title: Miaomiao2 and Miaomiao1 new firmware support
symptom: Users are unable to use a L2 sensor with the modified app and want support for Miaomiao1 firmware 38 (and future versions) or Miaomiao2 with xDrip+.
fix: A beta version of xDrip that can recognise Miaomiao2 is available at https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2019.08.31, but it still needs one more PR to get merged to start working.
evidence_quote: There is a beta version of xDrip that can recognise Miaomiao2, but remember, it is a beta version you can find the version here : https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/releases/tag/2019.08.31
